description: This file implements the SystemInfo class and related nested classes within the Thunder::PluginHost namespace. It manages system information such as network, security, location, device ID, time, and software version, providing methods for registration, updates, and data retrieval.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Main class providing system information and management functions.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Internet
classes.description: Handles network-related information such as IP address and network type.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Location
classes.description: Contains location data such as timezone, country, region, city, latitude, and longitude.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Id
classes.description: Represents device identification details including identifier, architecture, chipset, and firmware version.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Register
methods.description: Registers a notification client for system info updates.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RawDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of a network interface.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Update
methods.description: Triggers an update of system info and optionally calls back.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RecursiveList
methods.description: Recursively calls the Updated method on notification clients.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Internet::Set
methods.description: Sets the internet info based on provided data.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Security::Set
methods.description: Sets the security info based on provided data.
